title: drivers
description: One document per driver. The Add / Edit Driver form (the hiring application in page mode) writes it section by section. Personal data: `ssn` is stored encrypted with only the last four in clear; `dob` and licence numbers are personal too.

driverType.description: Picked at the top of the form; drives labels and the HOS window.

name.description: "First Last", kept for search and lists.

ssnEncrypted.description: SSN / SIN encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM, key outside the DB).

us.description: Legal right to work in the United States.

ca.description: Legal right to work in Canada.

operatesInUS.description: "Will this driver operate in or cross into the United States?"

hiredDate.description: Start date; every tenure / DQ clock counts from it.

dateAdded.description: When the record was entered (on or after `hiredDate`). The "Added to fleet" column.

street.description: Street line, as written on the record.

previousResidences.description: `{ address, unit, country, city, state, zip, startDate, endDate }` when `resided3Years` is false.

emergencyContacts.description: `{ name, relation, phone, email }`; the form captures the first.

licenses.description: Repeatable: `{ number, country, authority, class, issueDate, expiryDate, medicalExpiry, current, commercial, endorsements[], restricted, restrictions, isPrimary, status, frontDocumentId, backDocumentId }`. `class` is one of "Class 1 / A" … "Class M".

licensePrimary.description: `{ number, state, expiry }` copied from the primary licence for lists.

disqualification.description: Six questions keyed `denied, drivingWhileSuspended, alcoholOffense, substanceOffense, reckless, failedDotTest` → `{ answer: "Yes"|"No", when: {m,y}, explain, documentId }`.

travel.description: `{ citizenshipCountry, workAuthUS, workAuthCA, passport{ number, country, expiry, documentId }, visa{ has, number, type, expiry, documentId, monitor, reminderDays[] }, workPermit{…}, twic{ has, number, expiry, documentId }, fast{…} }`. Each document is also filed as a compliance record.

drivingExperience.description: `{ equipmentClass, freightTypes[], regions[], from, to, miles, ownerOperator }`.

employment.description: `{ company, start, end, address…, telephone, position, reasonLeaving, terminated, current, mayContact, operatedCMV, subjectFMCSR, safetySensitive, documentIds[] }`.

education.description: `{ school, start, end, city, state, country, telephone, study, graduation }`.

accidents.description: `{ date, type, state, commercialVehicle, atFault, ticketed, details }`.

violations.description: `{ date, charge, state, commercialVehicle, penalty, fineAmount }`.

military.description: `{ served, country, branch, start, end, rank, dd214, dd214DocumentId }`.

hos.description: `{ days: { "YYYY-MM-DD": hours }, note }` — 8 days (US) or 14 (Canada / cross-border) before `hiredDate`.

dqCompletionPct.description: Computed: DQ file completeness. The "DQ File" column.

complianceMissing.description: Computed: required records missing. The "n missing" chip.

deletedAt.description: Soft delete (TO CONFIRM) — keeps compliance history readable.

createdAt.description: Set by the server on insert.

updatedAt.description: Set by the server on every write.
